function: Jointly learns RIS phase shifts and UAV trajectory to maximize correctly transmitted bits minus UAV energy, from observed SNR only, without UT location or CSI (p. 9).
system: Downlink BS to K=6 single-antenna UTs via UAV-mounted passive reflecting RIS (UPA, M=16), OFDM, LoS links; carrier frequency not stated, bandwidth 2.16 GHz (p. 4, p. 8).
method: DDPG actor-critic RL trained online; decision transformer (GPT, causal self-attention) trained offline on 500,000 DDPG-collected trajectories with L2 loss; target return 47 (p. 11, p. 17, p. 23).
data_channel: Simulated LoS BS-RIS and RIS-UT channels with path loss and blocking probability; UTs random in 200 m square; 500,000 DDPG trajectories train DT (p. 6, p. 11, p. 18).
test_conditions: Train: UT locations random per episode in 200 m square (p. 11). Test: UTs in [75,100]x[75,100], larger region, moving UTs in two stages; M swept (p. 19, p. 22).
baselines: Non-learned: penalty-method gradient-ascent optimization with known UT locations and CSI; S-CSI RIS design without UAV. Learned: only DDPG and DT, both proposed (p. 18, p. 19).
metrics: Return (correct bits minus weighted UAV energy), user bits (CDF, mean, vs M), SER vs SNR for QPSK and 16QAM, training episodes and loss (p. 19-25).
q1_support: p. 4: "The reflective links are assumed to be LoS channels since the UAV is flying"; own LoS UPA model with path loss at 1 m and a blocking probability (p. 5, p. 6); no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 22: "To verify the generalizability of DT, we further evaluate the decision-making capability of the UAV while UTs are moving" with the trained model; training episodes draw UT locations in a p. 11: "200 m-by-200 m square area" (Algorithm 1), without moving UTs.
q3_support: p. 18: "For comparison, we adopt the following two benchmark schemes", both non-learned (optimization with known information; S-CSI without UAV). DDPG and DT are the paper's own training algorithms, p. 1: "is employed as an alternative for RL model training"; no earlier learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 25: "instead of the computational complexity" - the paper declines to report it and gives only training episodes, p. 23: "it requires about 500 episodes for DDPG to finally converge"; no FLOPs, parameters or runtime appear.
q5_support: p. 18: "contains a total of 500,000 trajectories" - generated by the authors' own DDPG policy; no code or data link appears in the text, and footnotes and references are missing from this capture.
notes: The PDF is a capture of the IEEE Xplore HTML page (record 10758222), not the publisher's PDF (p. 1); title and DOI on p. 1 match. Footnotes 1-6 and the reference list are absent (p. 28 is blank), so a code link in a footnote cannot be excluded for q5. Area 6 chosen because the learned control (RIS phase shifts of an aerial link plus UAV trajectory) is on a UAV link and 6 outranks 3; area 3 if a low-altitude UAV relay is not read as NTN. q2 judgement: Figs. 4-5 test areas lie inside the training square and do not count; Fig. 8 moves the UTs with the trained model. q3 judgement: DDPG and DT are two proposed training algorithms of one RL model, so no independent learned baseline; q3 would be 1 only if DDPG is read as a standard baseline for DT.
